label: copy-phase input x followed by t (x->t bigram recall)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost exclusively (98.5% of mass) when the fed-back input is x, and essentially only when that x sat at original position >= 2 (recall_idx >= 3). It does not fire on most such x inputs, however (precision of x-input alone is ~8%). Magnitude is driven by what follows x in the original: the strongest activations (top quartile, up to max) are on x when the next output is t, especially in x t t patterns; x followed by t one step later also fires. x inputs not followed by t give only weak activations (bottom quartiles), and a small residue (~1.5% of mass) is on t inputs right after x. Never fires in the original or delimiter phases, on x at original positions 0-1, or on first occurrences of a token. Predicate (x input, recall_idx>=3, t next or next-next) gets dev F1 ~0.61, mass recall ~0.75; the remaining weak x activations are not captured.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=x (+7.26), phase=2 & in_tok=t (+5.59), in_tok=x (+4.29), phase=2 & out_tok=t (+3.47), next_out=t (+3.39), out_tok=t (+3.37). Lower it: correct=1 (-5.14), to_go=6 (-3.90), out_tok=h (-2.79), next_out=f (-2.50).
